objective_value: <float> Equal-weighted combined cost (one-half of the first total cost plus one-half of the second total cost) at the non-dominated solution that minimizes this weighted sum.
pareto_front: <list[list[int]], shape [num_nondominated_points][2]> Complete set of non-dominated cost pairs, each pair giving the first total cost and the second total cost of a non-dominated solution.

solutions.z1: <int> First total cost (sum of fixed opening costs and assignment costs under the first cost structure) of this non-dominated solution.
solutions.z2: <int> Second total cost (sum of fixed opening costs and assignment costs under the second cost structure) of this non-dominated solution.
solutions.open_facilities: <list[int]> Indices of facilities that are opened in this non-dominated solution.
solutions.assignments: <dict, key: '{customer}'> Index of the open facility to which each customer is assigned in this non-dominated solution.
